purpose: Preserve all frozen groups while using one universal metadata-only processing-version rule: the unique most recently updated valid DECam InstCal ooi image for the same original observation, followed by unique all-anchor header-WCS detector resolution.

archive_identity.authority: NSF NOIRLab Astro Data Archive public REST API
archive_identity.c4d_observation_rule: Remove only the terminal processing-version token from the frozen c4d exposure name and query the complete calibrated ooi/filter prefix.
archive_identity.tu_observation_rule: Derive c4d_YYMMDD_HHMMSS from the exposure's unique frozen ct4mYYYYMMDDtHHMMSS SIA association ID and require the matching-filter ooi science product.
archive_identity.candidate_requirements: All candidates must be DECam InstCal object images with the frozen filter and must share exactly one original_filename observation identity.
archive_identity.processing_version_rule: Select the unique candidate with the lexically greatest Archive file_updated timestamp.

archive_header_resolution.selection_rule: Require exactly one two-dimensional celestial-WCS header in the selected current Archive file to contain every frozen anchor assigned to the group.

retrieval.invalid_payload_retry_rule: HTTP failure, missing image data, decompression failure, malformed FITS, WCS mismatch, detector mismatch, non-finite image, or invalid present checksum keyword consumes one of the same three attempts and is never persisted.
retrieval.resume_rule: Reuse an existing exact V19AR output only after fully revalidating it against the frozen structural, detector, WCS, finite-pixel and present-checksum gates.

claim_boundary: V19AR changes only the processing-version identity policy. All targets, group memberships, coordinates, filters, and observation identities remain frozen.
The latest-current rule uses Archive metadata only and is uniform across all exposures; it does not respond to target flux, PSF, morphology, lensing, halo, or gravity outcomes.
Each detector is independently selected by full-header WCS containment, never by detector-number arithmetic.
A pass establishes complete calibrated detector retrieval and structural integrity only; it does not establish photometry, color, stellar mass, mass current, lensing, or Sigma-field validity.
Every exact downloaded payload receives a SHA-256, and any embedded FITS CHECKSUM or DATASUM keyword that is present must validate.
